name: Flawed Facade
body:
Price 100 gp; Slot —; CL 1st; Weight —; Aura faint illusion

DESCRIPTION

The item’s apparent value is increased by 1d10 x 100 gp and the DC of Appraise checks to determine the item’s true value is increased by 5. The creator can apply this curse more than once to the same item, up to a maximum number of once per 2 caster levels. Its effects stack.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 50 gp; Spells bestow curse, disguise self
